scope: Bounded Protocol F3/F6 native source foundation: deterministic unpublished developer bundle, fail-closed verification, clean Python 3.11 install, verified extraction and cache-seeded offline reinstall/check.

source_identity.baseline_remote_relation: main matched origin/main before this slice
source_identity.worktree_identity: Task-owned source changes layered over the baseline; archive bytes are identified separately. The eventual source publication commit is recorded externally after commit to avoid a self-referential receipt.

bundle.determinism: Two independent builds from the same source bytes were byte-identical.
bundle.canonical_metadata: gzip filename absent and mtime zero; sorted GNU tar regular-file members use uid/gid 0, empty uname/gname, mtime zero, and manifest-bound 0644/0755 modes.
contents: Rich schemas, OpenAPI 3.1.1, SSE contract and compatibility 1.0.0 through 1.2.0
hub-http-v1@1.0.0 and edge-delivery-v2@2.0.0 complete profile directories and checksum maps
Conformance cases, adapters, generators, local tests and check entrypoints
Apache-2.0 licence, third-party locked-dependency notices and usable top-level documentation
excluded: Private runtime material, credentials and captured data
Third-party wheels and platform-specific virtual environments
Hub, App and downstream implementation source

focused_tests.command: uv run --python 3.11 python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_developer_bundle.py -v
assertions: Byte-identical builds and adjacent archive checksum
Closed manifest, exact lock identity and verified extraction
Tampered, missing or extra payload members fail
Links, parent traversal, duplicate names and parent/file conflicts fail
Raw gzip tails, concatenated gzip members and decoded post-tar bytes fail
A renamed archive root fails before destination or temporary extraction creation
Unknown manifest keys, changed contract identities and reordered file entries fail
Setuid, setgid and sticky mode variants fail

procedure: Built the source archive twice and compared exact bytes
Extracted through the standard-library safe extractor into a fresh temporary root
Set a fresh isolated UV_CACHE_DIR and ran uv sync --locked --python 3.11
Moved the created .venv out of the extracted source root
Ran UV_OFFLINE=1 uv sync --locked --python 3.11 against only the seeded exact cache
Ran UV_OFFLINE=1 ./tools/check from the verified extracted bundle

fail_closed_boundaries: Archive verification rejects non-canonical gzip/tar metadata, ordering and modes
Only regular files under the single expected versioned root are accepted
Manifest membership, every size/hash, checksum map, VERSION and uv.lock identity must agree
Extraction refuses an existing target and uses a verified temporary directory before atomic placement
Exactly one complete gzip member must decode to the byte-canonical tar stream with no trailing input
Manifest top-level and contract maps are closed, file entries are path-sorted and modes are exact 0644 or 0755
verification.source_neutrality_audit: No machine/prose conflict was encountered in the changed bundle surface. The complete unchanged schema/OpenAPI/profile/generator/conformance gate passed; the bundle adds no daemon, Hub implementation import, hidden Hub source dependency or private data.

accepted_by_this_receipt: Deterministic native developer source archive construction and verification
Complete public-resource inventory for this bounded bundle
Clean native Python 3.11 locked installation and complete local check
Offline environment recreation and full check after exact-cache seeding
not_accepted: Cold-cache offline dependency installation; dependency wheels are intentionally not redistributed
Hub catalog install, update, status, rollback or removal
Final Hub, TypeScript, Swift, Edge or Home Assistant artifact admission
F5 named-source import/parity or authorized passive evidence
App, Viewer, x86, x86_64, amd64, Intel, Azure, CI, release, tag, binary publication or production

independent_review.otherwise_reproduced: The reviewer reproduced the archive inventory/determinism and accepted the receipt's bounded claim calibration apart from the four verifier blockers.
findings_fixed: Reject raw bytes after gzip, concatenated gzip members and decompressed bytes after tar termination
Validate the exact versioned root before extraction target or temporary-directory creation
Close manifest top-level/contracts schemas and require canonical file-entry ordering
Reject setuid, setgid, sticky and all other non-exact archive modes

closures.single_gzip_and_canonical_tar: ACCEPT: raw post-gzip bytes, concatenated gzip members and decoded post-tar bytes are rejected.
closures.versioned_root_before_extraction: ACCEPT: renamed roots fail before destination creation and leave no temporary residue.
closures.closed_manifest_and_contracts: ACCEPT: exact top-level/contract keys and values plus canonical file-entry ordering are enforced.
closures.exact_archive_modes: ACCEPT: only raw 0644/0755 modes pass; setuid, setgid and sticky variants fail.

recheck.bounded_scope: Accepts only the deterministic native developer-bundle foundation and its calibrated receipt. Full F3/F6, ARM64 Docker, Hub catalog lifecycle, final consumer admission, F5 and F7 remain open.

cleanup.repository_archive_output: No archive is tracked or published; dist/ is ignored and the evidence artifact was built under a disposable temporary root.
